body.zh: 新增一个按日期排列的更新记录页，用来保存新文章发布、内容补充和网站功能调整。后续更新会继续追加到这里，形成可以回看的网站历史。
body.en: A chronological log for new essays, content changes, and site improvements. Future updates will be added here so the site’s development remains visible over time.

body.zh: 一篇中英双语长文，记录我如何使用倍速听课与听书、如何在内容浓缩和完整理解之间取舍，以及为什么有些时刻仍值得慢下来。文章保留八个部分，并提供可点击的章节目录。
body.en: A bilingual essay about accelerated listening, content compression, and the limits of efficiency—along with the moments that are still worth experiencing slowly. The full essay is organized into eight sections with a clickable table of contents.

title.zh: 完善博客的双语阅读与章节导航
title.en: Improved bilingual reading and section navigation

body.zh: 博客文章支持中文、英文和英中对照阅读，并增加可直接跳转到各章节与小节的目录，方便读者按兴趣阅读，也便于回看。
body.en: Blog essays now support English, Chinese, and side-by-side reading, with jump links to sections and subsections for easier navigation.

title.zh: 发布第一篇博客《健康，让生活更好》
title.en: Published the first essay, “Health for a Better Life”

body.zh: 从睡眠、饮食、运动、专注工作和社交生活中的日常实践出发，记录尝试之后的体会与调整。
body.en: A personal account of experiments and adjustments in sleep, diet, exercise, focused work, and social life.
